text_block_list.name: Mysterious Sunglassed Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Can't see anything! Argh, what are you girls doing?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Sunglassed Horsegirl 1
text_block_list.text: She… she knows it's us, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Sunglassed Horsegirl 2
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh～? Strange… 
Heard this totally works☆

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Sunglassed Horsegirl 3
text_block_list.text:
W-well, made it this far, 
push through to end!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ugh…! Finally see a… gain…? This… private beach…?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Y-yeah. So… make racket here, 
won't disturb anyone…

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Everyone…? Five of us chatting won't ——

text_block_list.name: Photo Shoot Makeup Staff
text_block_list.text: Good wooork～ We got invited too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: All shoot staff?

text_block_list.name: Resort PR Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well… hahah. Cheval Grand and friends approached us, 
decided to join too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even PR manager…? Resort staff…? 
Cheval, what is this…?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…"Only one without heartfelt 
expressions captured, can't be helped". 
Thought you'd dismiss it. But ——

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Laughed lot.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Made big commotion.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Had lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Amidst that, only you had few photos taken. 
Even though… gave us wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why… why…! Want you to… experience same 
feelings! Not returning favor… regrettable.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …… …………Puh. Ahahaha! This… got one up on me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……Far from all, Crown.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Right. Haven't unveiled 
main event… behold!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is this gargantuan dessert?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thanks for shoot. Wanted to surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
By way… Cheval and I made together. 
Not experienced, but learned how.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Two of you made huge dessert? 
Ah… looks like parfait, 
look closer ——

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Mango pudding, waffles, douhua… egg tarts… Ahaha, even turtle jelly!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Special dessert under supervision of 
Satono Grand Resort. Limited product… made 
for today. Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: 好犀利 (Impressive)... Every decoration is so pretty... Hehe, lovely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Favourite foods gathered here. 
Eaten local desserts in front of you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: That, umm… asked.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
我想請教下佢鐘意咩甜品……
(I'd like to ask what her favorite desserts are...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Your family. What desserts you like.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Tried fitting as many into dessert… Turned huge in end… ahahaha.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Cheval… Shion… thank you. 
Didn't expect wonderful surprise ——

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Eheh! Not end, Crown. 
More left. Ace up sleeves!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, thought up all these things, 
need you to enjoy every one♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—— Cheval, Crown, sorry for keeping waiting. 
I serve you. I ——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —— Student of "ultimate cuteness".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Duramente? Brought that swimsuit?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll explaaaiiin☆ Duramente asked help: 
"Want to draw Crown's smiling surprised face". 
Put together whole outfit for her!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
…Wearing new swimsuit to induce 
different attitude… learned from Cheval. 
Come, feed you personally.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Very cute! 
Learning wrong things, no?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …Aah, touched or retort? …Hehe, everyone put in effort for me…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: See, now, this moment… capture…!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Crown, don't think about expression. 
Most important: raw, heartfelt feelings.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Heheh…! …Right! Know that♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah… Surprised, shocked, laughed lot. Facial muscles put to work today.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: For me… case all days here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …Hehe, true. Almost never seen you change expressions often before.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…Yeah. Thanks to that… like myself more. 
Even now, feeling little like that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Thank you… for inviting.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Express gratitude too. Thanks to all, took great photos.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …Glad invited you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Me too… glad participated.

text_block_list.name: Crown & Cheval
text_block_list.text: ……Hehehe.
